        - heading "KEY FORMULAS" [level=2]
        - text: Euler identity
        - paragraph: e^(i theta) = cos theta + i sin theta
        - text: General complex number
        - paragraph: z = re^(i theta), r >= 0, theta in R
      - article:
        - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=2]
        - strong: Convert z = 3 + 4i to Euler form.
        - list:
          - listitem: "Find r: r = sqrt(3^2 + 4^2) = 5"
          - listitem: "Find theta: theta = atan(4/3) ~= 53.1 degrees"
          - listitem: "Trig form: 5(cos 53.1 degrees + i sin 53.1 degrees)"
          - listitem: "Euler form: 5e^(i53.1 degrees)"
        - paragraph: Therefore, 3 + 4i = 5e^(i53.1 degrees).
      - article:
        - heading "COMMON MISCONCEPTION" [level=2]
        - heading "Do not drop r!" [level=3]
        - paragraph: 5e^(i53.1 degrees) is not the same as e^(i53.1 degrees).
        - text: ✕ e^(i53.1 degrees)
        - generic: r = 1 (unit circle) -> (0.6, 0.8)
        - text: ✓ 5e^(i53.1 degrees)
        - generic: r = 5 -> (3, 4)
        - paragraph: General complex numbers keep the scale factor r.
      - heading "PRACTICE CHALLENGE" [level=2]
